title: scolymocephalus calocephalus
intro: Scolymocephalus calocephalus, commonly known as the "Fire Bush," is a flowering plant species within the Acanthaceae family. This shrub-like plant is native to tropical regions, known for its vibrant red and orange flowers, which attract birds and insects. The Fire Bush has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its purported health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Scolymocephalus calocephalus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
